read_documents_from_sitemap_or_folder: read documents from a local sitemap XML file or directory folder using langchain loaders
chunk_documents_with_overlap: split a list of documents into overlapping text chunks using RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
generate_questions_from_chunks: generate questions for each document chunk using an LLM via the OpenAI API protocol
generate_COT_answers: generate chain-of-thought answers for each question given its document chunk context
build_RAFT_dataset: build a RAFT fine-tuning dataset with Q-A-D triplets and optional refusal examples
